Patient Question (Development Draft): Have you felt tired more easily or had less energy than usual?
Have you experienced pain that is different from usual?
Have you had more trouble concentrating or forgetting things than usual?
Interpretation Caution: Acute mental status change requires separate risk triage

Patient Question (Development Draft): Have you had difficulty falling asleep or woken frequently?
Has your skin been itchy or uncomfortable?
Have you felt nauseated, lost your appetite, or had other stomach discomfort?
Interpretation Caution: Consider dehydration, uremia and other causes

Patient Question (Development Draft): Have you felt dizzy or as if you might faint?
Have your legs felt uncomfortable, making you want to keep moving them?
Have you been more short of breath or had difficulty breathing compared with usual?
Interpretation Caution: Acute or severe symptoms require immediate emergency response
